ei.title: Animals' Survivable Time Determines Their Biological Life Span
ei.subject: 11월_2023 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Animals' Survivable Time Determines Their Biological Life Span

fullPassage: Most mice in the wild are eaten or die before their life span of two years is over. They die from external causes, such as disease, starvation, or predators, not due to internal causes, such as aging. That is why nature has made mice to live, on average, for no longer than two years. Now we have arrived at an important point: The average life span of an animal species, or the rate at which it ages, is determined by the average time that this animal species can survive in the wild. That explains why a bat can live to be 30 years old. In contrast to mice, bats can fly, which is why they can escape from danger much faster. Thanks to their wings, bats can also cover longer distances and are better able to find food. Every genetic change in the past that made it possible for a bat to live longer was useful, because bats are much better able than mice to flee from danger, find food, and survive.

questions.passage: Most mice in the wild are eaten or die before their life span of two years is over. They die from (A)[visible / external] causes, such as disease, starvation, or predators, not due to (B)[internal / physical] causes, such as aging. That is why nature has made mice to live, on average, for no longer than two years. Now we have arrived at an important point: The average life span of an animal species, or the rate at which it ages, is (C)[estimated / determined] by the average time that this animal species can survive in the wild. That explains why a bat can live to be 30 years old. In contrast to mice, bats can fly, which is why they can escape from danger much faster. Thanks to their wings, bats can also cover longer distances and are better able to find food. Every genetic change in the past that made it possible for a bat to live longer was useful, because bats are much better able than mice to flee from danger, find food, and survive.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
① external — internal — determined: 원문 일치 ←정답
② visible(보이는) — internal — determined: (A) 오답
③ external — physical(신체적인) — determined: (B) 오답
④ external — internal — estimated(추정된): (C) 오답
det.tip: external(외적인), internal(내적인), determined(결정된)

questions.passage: Most mice in the wild are eaten or die before their life span of two years is over. They die from external causes, such as disease, starvation, or (A)[predators / parasites], not due to internal causes, such as aging. That explains why a bat can live to be 30 years old. In contrast to mice, bats can fly, which is why they can (C)[retreat / escape] from danger much faster. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
① parasites(기생충) — average — escape: (A) 오답
② predators — average — escape: 원문 일치 ←정답
③ predators — maximum(최대의) — escape: (B) 오답
④ predators — average — retreat(후퇴하다): (C) 오답
det.tip: predators(포식자), average(평균의), escape(탈출하다)

questions.passage: Most mice in the wild are eaten or die before their life span of two years is over. They die from external causes, such as disease, (A)[exhaustion / starvation], or predators, not due to internal causes, such as aging. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
① exhaustion(탈진) — genetic — flee: (A) 오답

④ starvation — genetic — hide(숨다): (C) 오답
det.tip: starvation(굶주림), genetic(유전적인), flee(달아나다)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

③ average: 야생에서의 '평균' 생존 시간 — 적절
④ perish(죽다) → survive(생존하다): 야생에서 '생존'할 수 있는 시간이라는 맥락에서 perish는 반대 의미 ←정답
det.tip: survive = 생존하다. perish(죽다)는 반의어

③ escape: 위험으로부터 '탈출'하다 — 적절

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

questions.passage: Most mice in the wild are eaten or die before their life span of two years is over. They die from external causes, such as disease, starvation, or predators, not due to internal causes, such as aging. That is why nature has made mice to live, on average, for no longer than two years. Now we have arrived at an important point: The average life span of an animal species, or the rate at which it ages, is determined by the average time that this animal species can survive in the wild. That explains why a bat can live to be 30 years old. In contrast to mice, bats can fly, which is why they can escape from danger much faster. Thanks to their wings, bats can also __________ and are better able to find food. Every genetic change in the past that made it possible for a bat to live longer was useful, because bats are much better able than mice to flee from danger, find food, and survive.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: cover longer distances (더 먼 거리를 이동하다)
det.analysis:
① avoid natural predators(천적을 피하다): 앞 문장(escape from danger)과 중복
② adapt to new environments(새 환경에 적응하다): 문맥과 무관
③ cover longer distances: 날개 덕분에 더 먼 거리를 '이동'할 수 있다 — 원문 일치 ←정답
④ develop stronger instincts(더 강한 본능을 발달시키다): 날개의 기능과 무관
